sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:124

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:124:1
items.html: And the lower joint of the Hod of Tevuna, within which is the Hod of the Tzelem, descends below into the Gevura of ZA: This follows the rule that is known, that with vessels it is always reckoned that the upper ones grow first, and the reverse is with lights, where it is always reckoned that the lower ones enter first. Therefore, in the clothing of the lights of Nefesh in the lower third of the Netzah of Tevuna, they are found clothed in the Hochma of ZA, which is the upper vessel of the Partzuf; and likewise the left line of the light of Nefesh, drawn with the lower third of the Hod of Tevuna, clothes in the Bina of ZA, which is the upper vessel of his left line. And it is now found that only the vessels of HB of ZA have the light of Nefesh within them, and the rest of the vessels of ZA are empty, without light. But afterward, when the light of Ruach reaches ZA, whose right line clothes in the middle third of the Netzah of Tevuna — behold, it too enters the upper vessel of the Partzuf, which is the Hochma of ZA; therefore the light of Nefesh, which had earlier been clothed in Hochma, can now descend to the Hesed of ZA. And likewise the left line of the light of Ruach, coming in the middle third of the Hod of Tevuna, also enters the upper vessel of ZA, which is Bina, and the light of Nefesh that was there now descends to Gevura. And so it is always: for the new light that now enters always enters the upper vessel, and the light that had been there earlier descends to the vessel below it. And the reason for this has already been explained in Inner Observation, Part 2. Study it there well.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:124:2
items.html: And in the seventh year, etc., the Atara [crown] of the Yesod of Tevuna enters, etc., into the Daat of ZA: This is the discernment of the middle line of the light of Ruach, and it enters the upper vessel of the middle line of ZA, which is the Daat. And one must be precise: that with the light of Nefesh, the middle line is not counted, only the two lines, right and left, alone — and the reason is that there is no discernment of a middle line in the lower thirds of the NHY of Tevuna, but only the two thirds of NH alone. And for this reason the fetus has no Daat, because the coupling is made upon the outer vessels of AVI, which are the discernment of the lower two thirds of NH, where there is no discernment of a decisor. For a decisor begins only with the light of Ruach, which is the discernment of the middle vessels. And understand this.
